name: dither-fx-canvas
title: Dither FX: canvas
author: PG Gonni <https://www.sekei.xyz>
description: Fills its positioned parent with a pixelated canvas running a dither effect.
docs: Pair it with one effect: `<DitherCanvas effect={fx} />`. Build the effect once (useMemo or module scope) - a new reference restarts the simulation.
